The '''Imperial Guest Performance''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] badge awarded to individuals who entertained Imperial troops. At least one was issued to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] in appreciation for entertaining several Imperial troops during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities.

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Guest Performance appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
